ev.text: Theron! I was hoping to run into you.
They say the pike in the lake are biting.
And here I am. What is on your mind?
A long day. Nothing a seat and a bowl of stew will not mend.
One of these weeks he will be right.
When all this is quieter, what will you do?
Nothing at all. It is just good to see a friendly face.
Then go and sit. The work will keep.
Sleep for a week. Then, who knows? You?
The same, I think. But it is good to wonder.

entry.text: Garrick and Dorn have grown close.

ev.text: My grandmother swore the old ruins were a lord's hall once.
Mine said worse things were buried there than lords.

entry.text: Brenna and Vex have tonight's watch.
